label.purpose: Compact metadata, filters, and table structure.

mono.purpose: Exact hashes, IDs, logs, and output.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant fallback when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action in a local context.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem .85rem; border: 0; border-radius: .5rem; background: oklch(0.52 0.19 42); color: white; font: 700 .875rem/1.5 system-ui; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.47 0.18 42); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 42); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: oklch(0.46 0.18 42); transform: none; }

components.name: Selected Inventory Row
components.description: A compact automation row with explicit health and revision identity.
components.css: .ds-inventory-selected { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .5rem .75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.06 43); border-radius: .5rem; background: oklch(0.955 0.032 47); color: oklch(0.19 0.018 43); text-align: left; } .ds-inventory-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 42); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Operator Scope
components.description: Environment, instance, and attributed actor at the operational decision point.
components.css: .ds-operator-scope { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(4rem,10rem); gap: .05rem .5rem; padding: .3rem .75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.009 43); border-radius: .5rem; background: oklch(0.982 0.003 43); color: oklch(0.47 0.018 43); text-align: left; } .ds-scope-env { grid-row: 1/3; align-self: center; padding: .12rem .42rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.95 0.025 205); color: oklch(0.42 0.095 205); font: 750 .6875rem/1.15 system-ui; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-operator-scope:hover { border-color: oklch(0.66 0.014 43); } .ds-operator-scope:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 42); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Werkt is a precise working surface: bright, compact, and designed around readings and controls rather than decoration. Dense operational facts are separated by calm whitespace and one-pixel rules.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for operational work, with calm whitespace between responsibilities.
Flat white and warm-neutral surfaces separated by one-pixel rules.
Exact revisions, event IDs, attempts, logs, and output remain visible system truth.
Responsive changes preserve the task hierarchy rather than merely shrinking it.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange indicates the next useful action or the current selection; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Words-and-Color Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color is paired with a visible label or icon so color is never the sole carrier of state.

rules.name: The Exactness Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for values an agent or operator may copy, compare, or search; do not use it as a visual theme.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Do not put shadows around inventory rows, sections, tables, or ordinary containers. Overlap must be real before elevation is used.

dos: Do lead with current lifecycle state and the next safe action.
Do preserve exact revision, run, event, and attempt data.
Do reflow dense tables into labeled rows on narrow screens.
donts: Don't assemble generic SaaS KPI dashboards from interchangeable metric cards.
Don't use cyberpunk agent-console styling, neon gradients, glass panels, or ornamental terminals.
Don't use semantic color without a visible textual state.
